description: One-page two-column partnership brief: headline strip, two body columns, a pull quote, a CTA, one logo slot and one hero image slot.

fields.name: headline
fields.description: Top strip, single line at 32pt. Overflow wraps to two lines and pushes the columns off the page.

fields.name: subheadline
fields.description: Sits under the headline at 16pt across the full width.

fields.name: column_left
fields.description: Left body column. Under 60 words leaves visible whitespace at the column foot.

fields.name: column_right
fields.description: Right body column. Should balance the left column in length.

fields.name: pull_quote
fields.description: Boxed quote spanning both columns at 18pt italic.

fields.name: cta
fields.description: Footer call to action, single line.

fields.name: hero_image
fields.description: Right-hand hero slot, 16:9. Value must be a placeholder token, not a URL.

fields.name: sender_logo
fields.description: Header logo slot for the sending company.

fields.name: accent_color
fields.description: Must name a key in theme_colors — not a raw hex value.
